messages.text: Task check: Getting a blank player on three items; can I safely continue tasking? (task ref AUDIO-9653)
The waveform loads but pressing Play never starts sound. Could you note whether the waveform loads but the playhead stays at zero?

This affected task cannot be evaluated while the player fails to load. Report the playback incident with its task ID; do not mark the recording as a model-quality failure. We should avoid QN as a content decision when playback itself is unavailable.
